taxes_sejour_parametres_check.name: taxes_sejour_parametres_check
taxes_sejour_parametres_check.value:
("taxes_sejour"."mode" = 'proportionnel' and "taxes_sejour"."taux" is not null and "taxes_sejour"."plafond" is not null)
          or ("taxes_sejour"."mode" = 'fixe' and "taxes_sejour"."tarif_fixe" is not null)

taxes_sejour_valeurs_check.name: taxes_sejour_valeurs_check
taxes_sejour_valeurs_check.value:
("taxes_sejour"."taux" is null or "taxes_sejour"."taux" > 0) and ("taxes_sejour"."plafond" is null or "taxes_sejour"."plafond" > 0)
          and ("taxes_sejour"."tarif_fixe" is null or "taxes_sejour"."tarif_fixe" >= 0) and "taxes_sejour"."taxe_additionnelle" >= 0
